Correction to “Vulvar lichen 
sclerosus”
CMAJ has been made aware of an error 
that occurred in the Oct. 12, 2021, issue.1
In the first paragraph, the sentence 
“We treated the patient with high-potency 
steroids (clobetasol ointment twice daily 
for 6 wk, then weekly).” should have read, 
“We treated the patient with high-potency 
steroids (clobetasol ointment twice daily 
for 6 wk, then daily).”
This has been corrected at cmaj.ca.
n Cite as: CMAJ 2021 November 15;193:
E1738. doi: 10.1503/cmaj.211806
Reference
1. Cleminson K, Baxter ML. Vulvar lichen sclerosus. 
CMAJ 2021;193:E1572.
